'''Credquant''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Binary star/Legends|binary stars]] [[Toydar/Legends|Toydar]] and [[Little Toydar/Legends|Little Toydar]] in the [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]], located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Credquant had four [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]], except [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
